about: Escalation with ESCALATION_MODE=real for a stub-mode account (PROGRESSION_MODE=stub, UID-b listed real) (MIGRATION_PLAN.md M29, area 6).
setup: INSERT INTO users (userId, name, notes, isAdmin) VALUES ('UID-a', 'Ada', 0, 0), ('UID-b', 'Bo', 0, 0)
finalQueries: SELECT json_group_array(json_object('accountId', accountId, 'caller', caller, 'route', route, 'body', body, 'status', status, 'reply', reply, 'note', note)) AS j FROM (SELECT * FROM progression_events ORDER BY id)

SELECT json_group_array(json_object('accountId', accountId, 'seasonId', seasonId, 'level', level, 'xp', xp, 'updateVersion', updateVersion, 'contentHash', substr(contentHash, 1, 12))) AS j FROM (SELECT * FROM escalationprogression ORDER BY accountId, seasonId)
SELECT json_group_array(json_object('accountId', accountId, 'talentId', talentId, 'rank', rank)) AS j FROM (SELECT * FROM escalationtalents ORDER BY accountId, talentId)
SELECT json_group_array(json_object('accountId', accountId, 'unlockId', unlockId)) AS j FROM (SELECT * FROM escalationunlocks ORDER BY accountId, unlockId)
